svg.title: HI-Large on Azure
svg.desc: Recorded execution topology · Single-VM batch processing · Source and results move through storage; computation stays on disk
svg.text: Recorded execution topology · Single-VM batch processing · Source and results move through storage; computation stays on disk
Azure CLI login on the VM
Docker image built on the VM
Python CLI stages read and write mounted local paths
Cut: 2022-10-07 · Full training split · Saved scores → evaluation
Recorded network: VNet + NSG + attached public IP
No NAT gateway; SSH rule later changed to Deny
Current reproduction adds commit archives and SHA-256 checks. Historical manifests do not preserve a container digest.
Solid arrows: transfer / data · Dashed teal: control / identity
GHCR and ACR did not supply the historical run image.
